payload.summary: Postgres holds users, conversations, turns, memories and follow_ups; memory is ours, ElevenLabs only supplies transcripts
details: users are three seeded rows (Alex, Sam, Priya) with fixed UUIDs; init seeds them with onConflictDoNothing on every deploy
conversations.id is the ElevenLabs conversation_id; opener is the first agent message actually spoken; extractedAt marks the extraction job as done
turns are unique on (conversationId, index) so webhook redelivery is a no-op; agent turns carry ElevenLabs LLM latency (llmTtfbMs, llmTtfSentenceMs)
memories and follow_ups are never deleted: supersededAt and resolvedAt retire them
No auth: anyone with the URL can act as any seeded user; acceptable for a demo
The web app calls the API at VITE_API_ORIGIN (empty in dev, where Vite proxies /api); production CORS allows config.WEB_ORIGIN
